root_cause.text: The driver’s .remove() handler did not unregister the ChromeOS EC (Embedded Controller) device, leaving a workqueue/kthread (`cros_ec_console_log_work`) still referencing the freed device after driver unbinding.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cros_ec_unregister(client_data->ec_dev)` in `cros_ec_ishtp_remove` to synchronously shutdown sub-devices; the CVE description states "After unbinding the driver, another kthread `cros_ec_console_log_work` is still accessing the device, resulting an UAF and crash."
